{{Top|ga}} {{Character |type=Rebel |image=[[File:DoctorQuadpaw-SWChrome2024.png]] |name=Quadpaw |homeworld= |birth= |death= |species=[[Jillsarian]]''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' |gender=[[Gender|Male]]{{Andor|The Eye}} {{AD|Disney+}} |pronouns=He/him{{Databank|doctor-quadpaw|Doctor Quadpaw}} |height= |mass= |hair=[[Color|White]]{{Andor|The Eye}} |feathers= |eyes= |skin=Light |cyber=Headpiece and [[eye]] lenses |families= |parents= |partners= |siblings= |children= |affiliation=*[[Axis network]] **[[Aldhani rebel infiltration team]] |masters= |apprentices= }} {{Quote|I did everything I could.|Quadpaw speaks about his operation on Nemik|audio=Quadpaw-Everything.flac|}} A skilled [[Jillsarian]] [[Gender|male]] [[Doctor|surgeon]] known only as Doctor '''Quadpaw''' worked on those in need who had nowhere else to turn, and the [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]] to pay, on the [[moon]] [[Frezno]]. In [[5 BBY]], a group of [[Aldhani rebel infiltration team|rebels]] who had just carried out a [[Aldhani heist|heist]] on the [[planet]] [[Aldhani]] brought their injured colleague [[Karis Nemik]] to Quadpaw, hoping he could save Nemik's life. The surgeon tried his best to treat the rebel, but was unable to save him. After the procedure was over, another of the rebels, [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]], held Quadpaw and the rebel [[Vel Sartha]] at [[blaster]]point before offering the surgeon thirty thousand credits for a [[starship]] and leaving. ==Biography== {{Quote|There's a doctor. We have it built into the contingency. She doesn't want to jeopardize the mission.|Skeen, talking about Quadpaw and Sartha|audio=Skeen-Doctor.flac|}} [[File:QuadpawOperates.png|thumb|right|300px|Doctor Quadpaw operated on Karis Nemik.]] The [[Jillsarian]] [[surgeon]] known only as [[Doctor]] Quadpaw worked out of a dimly lit operating theater in a domicile on the [[moon]] [[Frezno]], treating those who had nowhere else to turn and the [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]] to pay him. In [[5 BBY]],{{AndorDate|106}} he was part of the contingency plan for a [[Aldhani heist|heist]] carried out by a [[Aldhani rebel infiltration team|rebel infiltration team]] on the [[planet]] [[Aldhani]]. During the mission, in which the team stole a portion of an entire [[sector]]'s payroll from an [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[Aldhani Garrison|garrison]], the rebel [[Karis Nemik]] was seriously injured when a pallet of credits fell onto him and crushed his chest. The other three surviving members of the team—[[Vel Sartha]], [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]], and [[Arvel Skeen]]—debated if it was worth compromising the mission to take Nemik to Quadpaw but ultimately chose to meet with the doctor, bringing Nemik to him on Frezno. On the moon, Quadpaw worked on a sedated Nemik in his theater, injecting him with a syringe before beginning surgery. Sartha stayed with the doctor to assist during the operation while Andor and Skeen waited outside. Using forceps, Quadpaw felt around within an incision in the patient's lower back; however, despite his best efforts,{{SW|url=news/andor-episode-6-the-eye-highlights|text=''Andor'' Analyzed: 5 Highlights from Episode 6, "The Eye"|nolive=1}} the doctor was unable to save Nemik, who [[Death|died]] on the table. As Quadpaw wrapped up the procedure and wiped his head with a cloth, Sartha thanked him and then helped the surgeon cover Nemik with a sheet. Andor then entered, [[MW-20 Bryar pistol|blaster]] drawn. When Quadpaw noticed the [[Blaster|weapon]] he raised all four of his [[Limb|hands]] and, assuming that Andor was reacting to the death of Nemik, claimed that he had done everything he could for the deceased. [[File:QuadpawBlasterpoint.png|thumb|left|300px|Cassian Andor held Doctor Quadpaw and Vel Sartha at blasterpoint.]] Sartha then reassured the doctor that Andor was not aiming at him, believing that her [[mercenary]] colleague had betrayed them, but Andor surprised her as well by revealing that Skeen had been the one to suggest taking the money and leaving the others behind, for which Andor had killed him. Andor offered the doctor thirty thousand credits from his cut for a [[starship]] in a nearby barn and told them that he was going to take only the rest of his cut and leave. The doctor kept his hands raised as Andor handed a [[Kuati Signet]] to Sartha, who in turn gave him a [[The Trail of Political Consciousness|manifesto]] that Nemik had written, as per the rebel's dying wish. Andor advised them not to stick around and then left, staying true to his word and taking only what he was owed. ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|Thank you. Thank you for trying.|Sartha thanks Quadpaw|audio=Vel-ThanksDoctor.flac|}} [[File:DoctorQuadpaw-2024Base.png|thumb|200px|right|Quadpaw was a highly skilled surgeon.]] Quadpaw was a [[Gender|male]] Jillsarian with thinning [[Color|white]] [[hair]] and light skin. He was a skilled physician and used his four dexterous arms and [[Cybernetics|cybernetic]] enhancements to swiftly execute precise medical procedures on those in need but only if they had the credits. He tried his best to save Nemik, but his intensive efforts came up short.{{SW|url=andor-s1-e6-story-gallery|text="The Eye" Story Gallery | Andor}} {{C|Slide 9}} ==Equipment== {{Quote|I'll give you 30,000 credits for the ship in the barn. That's twice what it's worth.''"
"''Excuse me?|Andor and Quadpaw|audio=Andor-Quadpaw.flac|}} While working on Nemik, Quadpaw used a syringe, forceps, and various other medical tools. He wore a brown [[Clothing|shirt]] and brown apron and was equipped with cybernetic enhancements to improve his sight and hearing, including a headpiece and a lens over each of his [[eye]]s. Andor offered Quadpaw thirty thousand credits for a ship that he assumed belonged to the doctor and that the mercenary believed to be worth only half that price. ==Behind the scenes== {{Quote|Had the great pleasure of performing the arms for Quadpaw in #StarWars #Andor with Matt Lyons and Aidan Cook (under the makeup).|Paul Warren|{{Twitter|paulRwarren|1580121491563196416|[[Paul Warren]]|date=2022-10-12|quote=Had the great pleasure of performing the arms for Quadpaw in #StarWars #Andor with Matt Lyons and Aidan Cook (under the makeup).|archivedate=20221125193029}}}} [[File:QuadpawMaquette.png|thumb|right|300px|A maquette of Doctor Quadpaw was first revealed in the sizzle real for ''Andor''.]] Quadpaw was portrayed by [[Aidan Cook]], with [[Paul Warren]] and [[Matthew Lyons]] also acting as additional performers for the character, in "[[The Eye]]," the sixth episode of the television show ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]''{{'s}} [[Andor Season 1|first season]], which aired on [[October 12]], [[2022]].{{Twitter|starwars|status/1557442379975573504|[[Star Wars]]|date=2022-8-10|quote=This is what revolution looks like. Watch #Andor, a Star Wars Original Series, streaming only on @DisneyPlus September 21.|archivedate=20220810191942}} [[Luke Fisher]] designed and sculpted the character.{{Instagram|username=luke.d.fisher|url=p/CguhSwrK_qt|name=[[Luke Fisher]]|date=2022-08-01|quote=Good to see TwoTubes making an appearance in the new ANDOR trailer. I designed and sculpted TwoTubes for Rogue One, he’s still one of my personal favs! And the first look of another character, also designed and sculpted by myself. We had great fun bringing him to life, will hopefully be able to share more detail and designs soon. #andor #starwars #twotubes #creaturedesign #creatureconcept|archiveurl=https://archive.is/ZE3SP#selection-511.0-533.16|archivefile=File:LukeFisher-Quadpaw-Instagram.png}} Cook wore makeup to portray the character, while Warren and Lyons controlled the arms. Quadpaw's name was not spoken during the episode but was listed in the credits. Prior to the release of the show, a maquette of Quadpaw was shown during a sizzle real for ''Andor'' released on [[December 10]], [[2020]].{{SWYouTube|gSW-pARyP-M|Sizzle Reel | Andor | Disney+|sw_url=video/sizzle-andor}} The character was then fully revealed in the show's first full trailer, which released on [[August 1]], 2022.{{SWYouTube|cKOegEuCcfw|Andor | Official Trailer | Disney+ (2:25)|sw_url=video/andor-official-trailer}} ==Appearances== *{{Andor|The Eye}} {{1st}} ==Sources== *{{SWYouTube|gSW-pARyP-M|Sizzle Reel | Andor | Disney+|sw_url=video/sizzle-andor}} {{1stp}} *{{SWYouTube|cKOegEuCcfw|Andor | Official Trailer | Disney+ (2:25)|sw_url=video/andor-official-trailer}} *{{SW|url=news/andor-episode-6-the-eye-highlights|text=''Andor'' Analyzed: 5 Highlights from Episode 6, "The Eye"|nolive=1}} *{{SW|url=series/andor/andor-episode-6-the-eye|text="The Eye" Episode Guide | Andor}} *{{SWCT|set=2024 Base|cardname=Doctor Quadpaw}} *{{HomeVideoCite|set=Andor: The Complete First Season|featurette=Ferrix Part 2: Fight the Empire}} {{Video}} *''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' *{{SWYouTube|VOfBli5P7fs|Andor | Season 1 Recap | Streaming on Disney+ and Hulu|int=Andor Season 1 Recap}} *{{Databank|doctor-quadpaw|Doctor Quadpaw}} ==Notes and references== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Quadpaw|soundcat=Audio files of Quadpaw}} {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Quadpaw |ja=クワッドポー |ka=ოთხთათა |pl=Quadpaw }} [[Category:Aldhani rebel infiltration team members]] [[Category:Cyborgs]] [[Category:Individuals with he/him pronouns]] [[Category:Jillsarians]] [[Category:Males]] [[Category:Medical professionals]]
